messages.author: 8aa9b8cc06fdc99c
messages.subject: exception handling in RStan warmup?
parts:
I'm getting a behavior in the latest RStan where
a log prob error results in the sampler crashing
and no results being returned. Here's an example:

> fit <- stan('ma2.stan', data=list(T=T, y=y), iter=500, chains=4);

TRANSLATING MODEL 'ma2' FROM Stan CODE TO C++ CODE NOW.
COMPILING THE C++ CODE FOR MODEL 'ma2' NOW.
SAMPLING FOR MODEL 'ma2' NOW (CHAIN 1).
Iteration: 1 / 500 [ 0%] (Adapting)

Informational Message: The parameter state is about to be Metropolis rejected due to the following underlying, non-fatal
(really) issue (and please ignore that what comes next might say 'error'): Error in function
stan::prob::normal_log(N4stan5agrad3varE): Location parameter is -inf:0, but must be finite!
If the problem persists across multiple draws, you might have a problem with an initial state or a gradient somewhere.
If the problem does not persist, the resulting samples will still be drawn from the posterior.

Informational Message: The parameter state is about to be Metropolis rejected due to the following underlying, non-fatal
(really) issue (and please ignore that what comes next might say 'error'): Error in function
stan::prob::normal_log(N4stan5agrad3varE): Location parameter is -inf:0, but must be finite!
If the problem persists across multiple draws, you might have a problem with an initial state or a gradient somewhere.
If the problem does not persist, the resulting samples will still be drawn from the posterior.
Iteration: 50 / 500 [ 10%] (Adapting)
Iteration: 100 / 500 [ 20%] (Adapting)
Iteration: 150 / 500 [ 30%] (Adapting)
Iteration: 200 / 500 [ 40%] (Adapting)
Iteration: 250 / 500 [ 50%] (Adapting)
Iteration: 300 / 500 [ 60%] (Sampling)
Iteration: 350 / 500 [ 70%] (Sampling)
Iteration: 400 / 500 [ 80%] (Sampling)
Iteration: 450 / 500 [ 90%] (Sampling)
Iteration: 500 / 500 [100%] (Sampling)

SAMPLING FOR MODEL 'ma2' NOW (CHAIN 2).
Error : Error in function stan::prob::normal_log(N4stan5agrad3varE): Location parameter is -inf:0, but must be finite!
error occurred during calling the sampler; sampling not done
>

It somehow crashes before getting to iteration 50 and
never samples, and there's no resulting samples in the fit
object. Other times the same model will run fine.

- Bob

messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] exception handling in RStan warmup?
parts:
The issue is that it seems to have just stopped after the
error. Note that it doesn't report any samples for chain 2.
When I try to print the resulting fit object, it says

============================================
...
Iteration: 1800 / 2000 [ 90%] (Sampling)
Iteration: 2000 / 2000 [100%] (Sampling)

SAMPLING FOR MODEL 'ma2' NOW (CHAIN 4).

Error : Error in function stan::prob::normal_log(N4stan5agrad3varE): Location parameter is -inf:0, but must be finite!
error occurred during calling the sampler; sampling not done

>
>
>
>
>
>

> print(fit)
Stan model 'ma2' does not contain samples.
=================================================

It looks like what is happening is that exception thrown by normal_log
is happening in some context where it's not being caught. My guess is
that it's happening during the call to find reasonable parameters.

I should try to reproduce this from the command line. Now that I think
about it, the fix is probably below the level of the RStan interface
to the samplers.

I should also add that when I placed reasonable priors on some parameters,
this problem went away. So maybe this is a case where we want one of
the "posterior is improper" or some similar message.

- Bob
